atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: str_concat
atoms.rule: a ⊕ b joins string a followed by string b.
atoms.plain: a ⊕ b joins string a followed by string b.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊕ b 把字符串 b 接在 a 后面。

atoms.name: str_length
atoms.rule: a ℓ is the number of characters in string a.
atoms.plain: a ℓ is the number of characters in string a.
atoms.plain_zh: a ℓ 是字符串 a 的字符个数。

atoms.name: str_reverse
atoms.rule: a ↶ reverses the characters in string a.
atoms.plain: a ↶ reverses the characters in string a.
atoms.plain_zh: a ↶ 把字符串 a 倒过来。

atoms.name: str_first
atoms.rule: a ⌑ is its first character, or the empty string when a is empty.
atoms.plain: a ⌑ is its first character, or the empty string when a is empty.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⌑ 是 a 的第一个字符，空字符串得空字符串。

atoms.name: str_drop
atoms.rule: a ⇥ removes its first character; the empty string stays empty.
atoms.plain: a ⇥ removes its first character; the empty string stays empty.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⇥ 去掉 a 的第一个字符，空字符串保持为空。

atoms.name: str_upper
atoms.rule: a ⇧ changes each lowercase letter in a to uppercase.
atoms.plain: a ⇧ changes each lowercase letter in a to uppercase.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⇧ 把 a 中的小写字母改成大写。

atoms.name: str_lower
atoms.rule: a ⇩ changes each uppercase letter in a to lowercase.
atoms.plain: a ⇩ changes each uppercase letter in a to lowercase.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⇩ 把 a 中的大写字母改成小写。

atoms.name: str_equal
atoms.rule: a ≡ b is true exactly when strings a and b have the same characters.
atoms.plain: a ≡ b is true exactly when strings a and b have the same characters.
atoms.plain_zh: a ≡ b 在两个字符串完全相同时为真。

domain.en: Values are strings and integers. Strings may be empty; integers count characters and steps.
domain.zh: 取值是字符串和整数。字符串可以为空，整数用来数字符和步数。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms.
A recursive call repeats its step at most this many times; larger counts give NaN.
settings.zh: 递归最多重复这么多步，更大的次数得 NaN。

settings.en: The largest number of cases in a branch definition.
settings.zh: 分支定义最多的情形数。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ♠₁
operators.plain: Append b to a, then apply □₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 □₆。

operators.name: ☆₂
operators.plain: If a equals "", reverse a, then apply ♠₁ to the result and ""; otherwise reverse a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先把 a 倒过来，再对结果和 "" 应用 ♠₁；否则把 a 倒过来。

operators.name: ▽₃
operators.definition: a ▽₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▽₃ (b - 1)) △₂₅, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▽₃ (b + 1)) △₂₅, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply △₂₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 △₂₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♠₄
operators.plain: Append b to a, then reverse it.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再把结果倒过来。

operators.name: ♧₅
operators.plain: Apply ♠₄ to a and b, then append "B" to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♠₄，再在结果后面接上 "B"。

operators.name: □₆
operators.plain: Drop the first character of a, then turn it into uppercase.
operators.plain_zh: 先去掉 a 的第一个字符，再把结果转成大写。

operators.name: □₇
operators.plain: Append b to a, then keep its first character.
operators.plain_zh: 先在 a 后面接上 b，再只保留结果的第一个字符。

operators.name: ▼₈
operators.plain: Turn a into uppercase, then apply □₇ to the result and "".
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 转成大写，再对结果和 "" 应用 □₇。

operators.name: □₉
operators.plain: Apply ♠₁ to "a" and (a in uppercase).
operators.plain_zh: 对 "a" 和「大写的 a」应用 ♠₁。

operators.name: ■₁₀
operators.plain: Drop the first character of a, then append "a" to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先去掉 a 的第一个字符，再在结果后面接上 "a"。

operators.name: ♡₁₁
operators.plain: Take the remainder when dividing 4 by the length of a.
operators.plain_zh: 求 4 除以「a 的长度」的余数。

operators.name: ▲₁₂
operators.plain: Apply ♧₅ to a and b, then apply □₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₅，再对结果应用 □₉。

operators.name: ▼₁₃
operators.plain: Apply □₇ to a and b, then apply ▼₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 □₇，再对结果应用 ▼₈。

operators.name: △₁₄
operators.plain: Reverse a, then test whether the result equals "a".
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 倒过来，再判断结果是否等于 "a"。

operators.name: ♤₁₅
operators.plain: Apply □₇ to "" and (a without its first character).
operators.plain_zh: 对 "" 和「去掉首字符的 a」应用 □₇。

operators.name: ♦₁₆
operators.plain: Apply ♠₄ to a and b, then apply □₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♠₄，再对结果应用 □₆。

operators.name: ◆₁₇
operators.plain: Count the characters of a, then add 1 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 a 有几个字符，再把结果加上 1。

operators.name: △₁₈
operators.plain: Test whether "" equals a in lowercase.
operators.plain_zh: 判断 "" 是否等于「小写的 a」。

operators.name: ♦₁₉
operators.definition: a ♦₁₉ b = { (a ▲₁₂ b) □₆, if a ≡ "a"; a ▲₁₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ▲₁₂ to a and b, then apply □₆ to the result; otherwise compute a ▲₁₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₁₂，再对结果应用 □₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₁₂。

operators.name: ▽₂₀
operators.definition: a ▽₂₀ b = { (a ♧₅ b) ♠₄ "", if a ≡ ""; a ♧₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ♧₅ to a and b, then apply ♠₄ to the result and ""; otherwise compute a ♧₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₅，再对结果和 "" 应用 ♠₄；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₅。

operators.name: ◇₂₁
operators.definition: a ◇₂₁ b = { (a ⊕ b) ▼₈, if a ≡ "ab"; a ⊕ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "ab", append b to a, then apply ▼₈ to the result; otherwise append b to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "ab"，先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 ▼₈；否则在 a 后面接上 b。

operators.name: ◇₂₂
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▽₂₀ to "B" and (a without its first character); otherwise drop the first character of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，对 "B" 和「去掉首字符的 a」应用 ▽₂₀；否则去掉 a 的第一个字符。

operators.name: △₂₃
operators.definition: a △₂₃ b = { (a ⊕ b) ◇₂₂, if a ≡ ""; a ⊕ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", append b to a, then apply ◇₂₂ to the result; otherwise append b to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先在 a 后面接上 b，再对结果应用 ◇₂₂；否则在 a 后面接上 b。

operators.name: ♥₂₄
operators.definition: a ♥₂₄ b = { "a" ♠₄ (a ▼₁₃ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ▼₁₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ♠₄ to "a" and (a ▼₁₃ b); otherwise compute a ▼₁₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "a" 和 a ▼₁₃ b 应用 ♠₄；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₁₃。

operators.name: △₂₅
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▽₂₀ to "B" and (a ◇₂₂); otherwise apply ◇₂₂ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，对 "B" 和 a ◇₂₂ 应用 ▽₂₀；否则对 a 应用 ◇₂₂。

operators.name: ♢₂₆
operators.definition: a ♢₂₆ b = { (a ♦₁₆ b) △₂₃ "a", if a ≡ "a"; a ♦₁₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ♦₁₆ to a and b, then apply △₂₃ to the result and "a"; otherwise compute a ♦₁₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₁₆，再对结果和 "a" 应用 △₂₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₁₆。

operators.name: ♡₂₇
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ▼₁₃ to "" and (a ☆₂); otherwise apply ☆₂ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "" 和 a ☆₂ 应用 ▼₁₃；否则对 a 应用 ☆₂。

operators.name: ♣₂₈
operators.plain: If a equals "", keep only the first character of a, then apply ▽₂₀ to the result and "a"; otherwise keep only the first character of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先只保留 a 的第一个字符，再对结果和 "a" 应用 ▽₂₀；否则只保留 a 的第一个字符。

operators.name: ▼₂₉
operators.definition: a ▼₂₉ b = { (a ▽₂₀ b) ◇₂₂, if a ≡ ""; a ▽₂₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▽₂₀ to a and b, then apply ◇₂₂ to the result; otherwise compute a ▽₂₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₂₀，再对结果应用 ◇₂₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₂₀。

operators.name: ★₃₀
operators.plain: Apply ☆₂ to a, then drop its first character.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ☆₂，再去掉结果的第一个字符。

operators.name: ♠₃₁
operators.definition: a ♠₃₁ b = { (a ▲₁₂ b) ♢₂₆ "", if a ≡ ""; a ▲₁₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▲₁₂ to a and b, then apply ♢₂₆ to the result and ""; otherwise compute a ▲₁₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₁₂，再对结果和 "" 应用 ♢₂₆；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₁₂。

operators.name: ●₃₂
operators.plain: Apply ▽₂₀ to a and b, then apply □₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₂₀，再对结果应用 □₆。

operators.name: ■₃₃
operators.definition: a ■₃₃ b = { (a ●₃₂ b) ◇₂₂, if a ≡ "a"; a ●₃₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ●₃₂ to a and b, then apply ◇₂₂ to the result; otherwise compute a ●₃₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先对 a 和 b 应用 ●₃₂，再对结果应用 ◇₂₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ●₃₂。

operators.name: ♤₃₄
operators.definition: a ♤₃₄ b = { (a ▲₁₂ b) ■₃₃ "a", if a ≡ "a"; a ▲₁₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ▲₁₂ to a and b, then apply ■₃₃ to the result and "a"; otherwise compute a ▲₁₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₁₂，再对结果和 "a" 应用 ■₃₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₁₂。

operators.name: ▼₃₅
operators.plain: Apply ★₃₀ to a, then apply ▼₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ★₃₀，再对结果应用 ▼₈。

operators.name: ◇₃₆
operators.plain: Take the remainder when dividing 1 by a ♡₁₁.
operators.plain_zh: 求 1 除以 a ♡₁₁ 的余数。

operators.name: ♦₃₇
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ☆₂ to a, then drop its first character; otherwise apply ☆₂ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先对 a 应用 ☆₂，再去掉结果的第一个字符；否则对 a 应用 ☆₂。

operators.name: ♧₃₈
operators.plain: If a equals "a", turn a into lowercase, then apply ▼₈ to the result; otherwise turn a into lowercase.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先把 a 转成小写，再对结果应用 ▼₈；否则把 a 转成小写。

operators.name: ♤₃₉
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▼₈ to a, then apply ♧₅ to the result and "B"; otherwise apply ▼₈ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 应用 ▼₈，再对结果和 "B" 应用 ♧₅；否则对 a 应用 ▼₈。

operators.name: □₄₀
operators.plain: Apply ♠₃₁ to a and b, then apply ▲₁₂ to the result and "a".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♠₃₁，再对结果和 "a" 应用 ▲₁₂。

operators.name: ♧₄₁
operators.plain: Apply ♧₃₈ to a, then apply △₂₃ to the result and "a".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♧₃₈，再对结果和 "a" 应用 △₂₃。

operators.name: ♦₄₂
operators.definition: a ♦₄₂ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♦₄₂ (b - 1)) ↶, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♦₄₂ (b + 1)) ↶, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): reverse the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：把结果倒过来（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ◇₄₃
operators.definition: a ◇₄₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ◇₄₃ (b - 1)) ★₃₀, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ◇₄₃ (b + 1)) ★₃₀, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ★₃₀ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ★₃₀（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♧₄₄
operators.definition: a ♧₄₄ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♧₄₄ (b - 1)) ⇧, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♧₄₄ (b + 1)) ⇧, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): turn the current value into uppercase.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：把结果转成大写（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♣₄₅
operators.definition: a ♣₄₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♣₄₅ (b - 1)) ▼₃₅, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♣₄₅ (b + 1)) ▼₃₅, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ▼₃₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ▼₃₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ◆₄₆
operators.definition: a ◆₄₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ◆₄₆ (b - 1)) ⇩, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ◆₄₆ (b + 1)) ⇩, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): turn the current value into lowercase.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：把结果转成小写（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ☆₄₇
operators.definition: a ☆₄₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ☆₄₇ (b - 1)) ♤₃₉, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ☆₄₇ (b + 1)) ♤₃₉, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♤₃₉ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♤₃₉（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ◇₄₈
operators.definition: a ◇₄₈ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ◇₄₈ (b - 1)) ♧₃₈, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ◇₄₈ (b + 1)) ♧₃₈, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₃₈ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♧₃₈（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ◇₄₉
operators.definition: a ◇₄₉ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ◇₄₉ (b - 1)) ♦₃₇, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ◇₄₉ (b + 1)) ♦₃₇, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♦₃₇ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♦₃₇（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ■₅₀
operators.definition: a ■₅₀ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ■₅₀ (b - 1)) ♤₁₅, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ■₅₀ (b + 1)) ♤₁₅, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♤₁₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果应用 ♤₁₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♢₅₁
operators.plain: Apply ♦₄₂ to a and b, then apply ♡₂₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₄₂，再对结果应用 ♡₂₇。

operators.name: ▲₅₂
operators.plain: Apply ♢₅₁ to a and b, then count its characters.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₅₁，再数结果有几个字符。

operators.name: ♣₅₃
operators.plain: Apply ♣₄₅ to a and b, then apply ♧₅ to the result and "ab".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₄₅，再对结果和 "ab" 应用 ♧₅。

operators.name: ■₅₄
operators.plain: Apply ♦₁₆ to "ab" and (a ♧₄₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 "ab" 和 a ♧₄₄ b 应用 ♦₁₆。

operators.name: ◇₅₅
operators.plain: Apply ♢₅₁ to a and b, then apply ▼₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₅₁，再对结果应用 ▼₈。

operators.name: ♧₅₆
operators.plain: Apply ◇₄₈ to a and b, then apply ■₁₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₈，再对结果应用 ■₁₀。

operators.name: ♣₅₇
operators.plain: Apply ■₅₀ to a and b, then apply ♤₃₄ to the result and "B".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₅₀，再对结果和 "B" 应用 ♤₃₄。

operators.name: ▲₅₈
operators.plain: Apply ♧₅₆ to a and b, then apply ■₁₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₅₆，再对结果应用 ■₁₀。

operators.name: ♧₅₉
operators.plain: Apply ■₅₀ to a and b, then apply ♠₃₁ to the result and "B".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ■₅₀，再对结果和 "B" 应用 ♠₃₁。

operators.name: △₆₀
operators.plain: Apply ♣₅₃ to a and b, then apply ♤₃₄ to the result and "B".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♣₅₃，再对结果和 "B" 应用 ♤₃₄。

operators.name: ♤₆₁
operators.plain: Apply ◇₅₅ to a and b, then apply ▽₂₀ to the result and "B".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₅₅，再对结果和 "B" 应用 ▽₂₀。

operators.name: ★₆₂
operators.plain: Apply □₄₀ to "" and (a ◇₄₃ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 "" 和 a ◇₄₃ b 应用 □₄₀。

operators.name: ♡₆₃
operators.plain: Apply ♧₄₄ to a and b, then drop its first character.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₄₄，再去掉结果的第一个字符。

operators.name: ♧₆₄
operators.plain: Apply ▽₃ to a and b, then apply □₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₃，再对结果应用 □₆。

operators.name: ○₆₅
operators.plain: Apply △₂₃ to "ab" and (a ♣₅₇ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 "ab" 和 a ♣₅₇ b 应用 △₂₃。

operators.name: ♢₆₆
operators.definition: a ♢₆₆ b = { (a ▲₅₈ b) □₄₀ "ab", if a ≡ ""; a ▲₅₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▲₅₈ to a and b, then apply □₄₀ to the result and "ab"; otherwise compute a ▲₅₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₈，再对结果和 "ab" 应用 □₄₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₅₈。

operators.name: ♠₆₇
operators.definition: a ♠₆₇ b = { (a ♤₆₁ b) ♣₂₈, if a ≡ "a"; a ♤₆₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ♤₆₁ to a and b, then apply ♣₂₈ to the result; otherwise compute a ♤₆₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₆₁，再对结果应用 ♣₂₈；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₆₁。

operators.name: ♧₆₈
operators.definition: a ♧₆₈ b = { "ab" ●₃₂ (a ■₅₀ b), if a ≡ ""; a ■₅₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ●₃₂ to "ab" and (a ■₅₀ b); otherwise compute a ■₅₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，对 "ab" 和 a ■₅₀ b 应用 ●₃₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ■₅₀。

operators.name: ♥₆₉
operators.definition: a ♥₆₉ b = { (a ♤₆₁ b) ♧₅ "", if a ≡ ""; a ♤₆₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ♤₆₁ to a and b, then apply ♧₅ to the result and ""; otherwise compute a ♤₆₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₆₁，再对结果和 "" 应用 ♧₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♤₆₁。

operators.name: ♧₇₀
operators.definition: a ♧₇₀ b = { "a" ●₃₂ (a ♡₆₃ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ♡₆₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ●₃₂ to "a" and (a ♡₆₃ b); otherwise compute a ♡₆₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "a" 和 a ♡₆₃ b 应用 ●₃₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₆₃。

operators.name: ▽₇₁
operators.definition: a ▽₇₁ b = { "a" ♠₁ (a ♧₆₈ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ♧₆₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ♠₁ to "a" and (a ♧₆₈ b); otherwise compute a ♧₆₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "a" 和 a ♧₆₈ b 应用 ♠₁；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₆₈。

operators.name: ▲₇₂
operators.definition: a ▲₇₂ b = { (a ◇₄₈ b) ♤₃₉, if a ≡ ""; a ◇₄₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ◇₄₈ to a and b, then apply ♤₃₉ to the result; otherwise compute a ◇₄₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₈，再对结果应用 ♤₃₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₄₈。

operators.name: ♣₇₃
operators.definition: a ♣₇₃ b = { (a ◇₅₅ b) ◇₂₂, if a ≡ ""; a ◇₅₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ◇₅₅ to a and b, then apply ◇₂₂ to the result; otherwise compute a ◇₅₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₅₅，再对结果应用 ◇₂₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◇₅₅。

operators.name: ○₇₄
operators.definition: a ○₇₄ b = { "a" ■₃₃ (a ♦₄₂ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ♦₄₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ■₃₃ to "a" and (a ♦₄₂ b); otherwise compute a ♦₄₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "a" 和 a ♦₄₂ b 应用 ■₃₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♦₄₂。

operators.name: ♤₇₅
operators.definition: a ♤₇₅ b = { "a" ♦₁₉ (a ♧₅₆ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ♧₅₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ♦₁₉ to "a" and (a ♧₅₆ b); otherwise compute a ♧₅₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "a" 和 a ♧₅₆ b 应用 ♦₁₉；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♧₅₆。

operators.name: ▼₇₆
operators.definition: a ▼₇₆ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▼₇₆ (b - 1)) ♢₆₆ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▼₇₆ (b + 1)) ♢₆₆ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♢₆₆ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♢₆₆（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ▼₇₇
operators.definition: a ▼₇₇ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▼₇₇ (b - 1)) ♧₆₈ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▼₇₇ (b + 1)) ♧₆₈ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₆₈ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♧₆₈（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: □₇₈
operators.definition: a □₇₈ b = { a, if b == 0; (a □₇₈ (b - 1)) ♧₆₄ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a □₇₈ (b + 1)) ♧₆₄ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₆₄ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♧₆₄（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ▼₇₉
operators.definition: a ▼₇₉ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▼₇₉ (b - 1)) ♧₅₆ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▼₇₉ (b + 1)) ♧₅₆ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₅₆ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♧₅₆（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♡₈₀
operators.definition: a ♡₈₀ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♡₈₀ (b - 1)) ♤₆₁ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♡₈₀ (b + 1)) ♤₆₁ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♤₆₁ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♤₆₁（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: △₈₁
operators.definition: a △₈₁ b = { a, if b == 0; (a △₈₁ (b - 1)) ♧₇₀ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a △₈₁ (b + 1)) ♧₇₀ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♧₇₀ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♧₇₀（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ☆₈₂
operators.definition: a ☆₈₂ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ☆₈₂ (b - 1)) ♤₇₅ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ☆₈₂ (b + 1)) ♤₇₅ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply ♤₇₅ to the current value and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b| 次：对结果和 1 应用 ♤₇₅（b 取 -8 到 8，其余为 NaN）。

operators.name: ♧₈₃
operators.plain: Apply ▼₇₆ to a and b, then apply ♦₁₉ to the result and "".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₇₆，再对结果和 "" 应用 ♦₁₉。

operators.name: ♥₈₄
operators.plain: Apply ▼₇₆ to a and b, then apply ■₁₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₇₆，再对结果应用 ■₁₀。

operators.name: ♡₈₅
operators.plain: Apply ▼₇₇ to a and b, then turn it into lowercase.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₇₇，再把结果转成小写。

operators.name: △₈₆
operators.plain: Apply ♥₈₄ to a and b, then apply ▼₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₈₄，再对结果应用 ▼₈。

operators.name: ◆₈₇
operators.plain: Apply ♡₈₀ to a and b, then apply □₆ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₈₀，再对结果应用 □₆。

operators.name: ▽₈₈
operators.plain: Apply ☆₈₂ to a and b, then apply ♧₆₈ to the result and 1.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₈₂，再对结果和 1 应用 ♧₆₈。

operators.name: ▲₈₉
operators.plain: Apply □₇₈ to a and b, then apply ◇₅₅ to the result and 3.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 □₇₈，再对结果和 3 应用 ◇₅₅。

operators.name: ♦₉₀
operators.plain: Apply ▲₈₉ to a and b, then test whether the result equals "a".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₉，再判断结果是否等于 "a"。

operators.name: ▲₉₁
operators.plain: Apply ▲₈₉ to a and b, then count its characters.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₉，再数结果有几个字符。

operators.name: ♡₉₂
operators.plain: Apply ▲₈₉ to a and b, then apply ♠₁ to the result and "ab".
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₈₉，再对结果和 "ab" 应用 ♠₁。

operators.name: ▽₉₃
operators.plain: Apply ♥₈₄ to a and b, then turn it into uppercase.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 和 b 应用 ♥₈₄，再把结果转成大写。

operators.name: ♥₉₄
operators.definition: a ♥₉₄ b = { 2 % (a ▲₉₁ b), if a ≡ ""; a ▲₉₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", take the remainder when dividing 2 by a ▲₉₁ b; otherwise compute a ▲₉₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，求 2 除以 a ▲₉₁ b 的余数；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₉₁。

operators.name: ♤₉₅
operators.definition: a ♤₉₅ b = { (a ▲₉₁ b) + 4, if a ≡ ""; a ▲₉₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▲₉₁ to a and b, then add 4 to it; otherwise compute a ▲₉₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₉₁，再把结果加上 4；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▲₉₁。

operators.name: □₉₆
operators.definition: a □₉₆ b = { "" ♧₅ (a ▽₉₃ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ▽₉₃ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ♧₅ to "" and (a ▽₉₃ b); otherwise compute a ▽₉₃ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "" 和 a ▽₉₃ b 应用 ♧₅；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▽₉₃。

operators.name: ♣₉₇
operators.definition: a ♣₉₇ b = { (a ▼₇₇ b) ♣₇₃ 3, if a ≡ ""; a ▼₇₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ▼₇₇ to a and b, then apply ♣₇₃ to the result and 3; otherwise compute a ▼₇₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₇₇，再对结果和 3 应用 ♣₇₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ▼₇₇。

operators.name: ♢₉₈
operators.definition: a ♢₉₈ b = { "a" ■₃₃ (a ◆₈₇ b), if a ≡ ""; a ◆₈₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ■₃₃ to "a" and (a ◆₈₇ b); otherwise compute a ◆₈₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，对 "a" 和 a ◆₈₇ b 应用 ■₃₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₈₇。

operators.name: ☆₉₉
operators.definition: a ☆₉₉ b = { (a ◆₈₇ b) ♣₇₃ 4, if a ≡ ""; a ◆₈₇ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "", apply ◆₈₇ to a and b, then apply ♣₇₃ to the result and 4; otherwise compute a ◆₈₇ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 ""，先对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₈₇，再对结果和 4 应用 ♣₇₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₈₇。

operators.name: ♥₁₀₀
operators.definition: a ♥₁₀₀ b = { "B" ▽₂₀ (a ☆₈₂ b), if a ≡ "a"; a ☆₈₂ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals "a", apply ▽₂₀ to "B" and (a ☆₈₂ b); otherwise compute a ☆₈₂ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a 等于 "a"，对 "B" 和 a ☆₈₂ b 应用 ▽₂₀；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ☆₈₂。
